group.div: ADMS Setup: On your ZKTeco device, go to Menu → Comm → Cloud Server Setting and enter your Odoo server address and port (8069).

ul.li: Traditional Mode: Uses punch type from device (0=Check-in, 1=Check-out). Standard mode.
Auto Mode (NEW): Automatically determines check-in/check-out based on last attendance. Ignores device punch type. Prevents HR configuration mistakes!

div.p: The timeout controls how long the system waits for attendance events during live monitoring:

ul.li: For LOCAL network (192.168.x.x): 60 seconds ✓ (Default - Balanced)
For PUBLIC IP (Internet): 90-120 seconds ✓ (Recommended for remote connections)
For Slow/Unstable connections: 120-180 seconds (Higher tolerance)

div.p: Note: Higher timeout values give more patience for network delays, which is essential when connecting to devices over the internet. This prevents missing attendance events due to network latency!

page.name: device_info
page.div: Tip: Click "Refresh Device Info" button to update all information from the device.

div.p: One or more capacity metrics exceed 80% threshold. Consider clearing old records or adding more devices.
Real-time Mode: Attendance events are captured INSTANTLY as they happen!

ul.li: No more 5-minute polling delay
Instant notifications via Odoo bus
Automatic LCD messages and audio feedback
Real-time dashboard updates

div.p: Click "Start Live Capture" in the header to begin monitoring.

ul.li: For LOCAL network (192.168.x.x): 60 seconds ✓ (Default - Fast & Efficient)
For PUBLIC IP (Internet): 90-120 seconds ✓ (Recommended - Accounts for latency)
For Poor Connection: 120-180 seconds (Higher tolerance for delays)

div.p: Tip: Higher timeout = More patience before checking status. This is especially important when connecting via internet/public IP!
Live Capture enables real-time attendance monitoring. When enabled:

ul.li: Attendance events are captured as they happen (instead of polling every X minutes)
Instant notifications sent to relevant users
LCD messages and audio feedback triggered automatically
Better user experience and faster data sync

div.p: To enable: Check "Enable Live Capture" checkbox and click "Start Live Capture" button.

ul.li: LCD Messages: Max 20 characters per line. Use {name} placeholder for employee name (if supported by device).
Audio Alerts: Voice index 0-55. Different sounds available. 0=default beep, 1=error beep.
Testing: Use test buttons to preview LCD messages and audio sounds before enabling.

div.p: Door control features are enabled. Use with caution!

ul.li: Only authorized personnel should have access to door unlock
All door unlock actions are logged in the chatter
Default unlock duration: seconds

div.p: If your biometric device is connected to an access control system, you can enable door control features.

ul.li: Manual door unlock button
Check lock status
Configurable unlock duration
Activity logging for security audit

div.p: Note: This feature requires compatible ZKTeco device with door control capability.
